title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・『嬉しい』

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon overcomes her rivals and wins the spring Tenno Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She feels happiness for the first time and is at a loss for how to deal with the emotion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having tasted the joy of victory, she begins to crave more.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As a result, we decide to enter the Japan Cup, where the powerful Tokai Teio will surely be racing.
